snippet.title: Gothic 1 Remake | Xardas Trailer
snippet.description:
Gothic 1 Remake launches in early 2026 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S – and the Nyras Demo is available on consoles right now!

Alkimia Interactive is bringing the iconic classic back with modern visuals and refined gameplay while preserving the soul of the original. For the first time, console players can step into the world beneath the Barrier with the Nyras Prologue – available now on PlayStation and Xbox.

- Nyras Prologue -
